description: Header file defining internal structures, constants, and function prototypes for the private layer of the Dynamic Bass Enhancement (LVDBE) module in an audio processing library.

methods.name: LVDBE_SetAGC
methods.description: Sets the Automatic Gain Control parameters for a given LVDBE instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume parameters for a given LVDBE instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_SetFilters
methods.description: Configures the filters (high pass and band pass) for a given LVDBE instance.
